finding.allow_update_by_address.descript: Zone {{zone}} accepts dynamic updates from addresses: {{addresses}}.
finding.allow_update_by_address.risk: Clients updating by address only are refused afterwards; they need a TSIG key.
finding.dnssec_validation_off.risk: Answers from broken or misconfigured signed zones become SERVFAIL for recursive clients.
finding.kea_ctrl_agent_http.description: kea-ctrl-agent serves the Kea API in clear HTTP on {{address}}.
finding.kea_ctrl_agent_http.description_: kea-ctrl-agent serves the Kea API in clear HTTP on {{address}} without authentication.
finding.kea_ctrl_agent_http.proposal: Stop and disable kea-ctrl-agent: Pelagos uses the Unix control sockets of each daemon.
finding.kea_ctrl_agent_http.risk: Tools that talk to the agent over HTTP (Stork, scripts) stop working; give them HTTPS with trust-anchor, cert-file and cert-required instead.
finding.kea_http_socket_plain.descriptio: {{engine}} exposes its control channel in clear HTTP on {{address}}.
finding.kea_http_socket_plain.proposal: Switch the socket to https with trust-anchor, cert-file, key-file and cert-required, or bind it to 127.0.0.1.
finding.kea_http_socket_plain.risk: Remote clients of this socket need certificates.
finding.kea_socket_dir_mode.description: The Kea socket directory {{path}} is mode {{mode}}: other users can reach the control sockets.
finding.kea_socket_dir_mode.risk: Local users outside the Kea group lose access to the sockets (intended).
finding.kea_tsig_clear_secret.descriptio: D2 key {{key}} has its secret in clear in the configuration (Kea 3.x refuses this).
finding.kea_tsig_clear_secret.proposal: Move it to a secret-file (0640, Kea group) under the Kea configuration directory.
finding.kea_tsig_clear_secret.risk: None for DDNS; the configuration file no longer carries the secret.
finding.open_allow_transfer.description_: The options allow zone transfers to any client.
Zone {{zone}} allows zone transfers to any client.
finding.open_allow_transfer.risk: Secondaries that transfer by address only must be listed or given a key, or their transfers fail.
finding.open_recursion.description: Recursion is open to any client (open resolver, usable for amplification attacks).
finding.open_recursion.risk: Clients outside the local networks lose recursive resolution through this server.
finding.rndc_nonlocal.description: The rndc control channel listens on {{address}} and allows {{allowed}}.
finding.rndc_nonlocal.risk: Remote rndc users (monitoring, scripts on other hosts) lose access.
finding.static_zone.description: Zone {{zone}} is static (no allow-update, no update-policy): Pelagos edits its zone file on the node that holds it (named-checkzone, serial bump, rndc reload). As a dynamic zone it would take record changes by signed UPDATE like the other zones.
finding.static_zone.risk: named then records changes in a journal ({{file}}.jnl) and rewrites the zone file itself: edit it by hand only between `rndc freeze {{name}}` and `rndc thaw {{name}}`, and its directory must be writable by named. Comments and formatting of the file are lost at the first rewrite.
finding.stats_nonlocal.description: The statistics channel listens on {{address}} and allows {{allowed}}.
finding.stats_nonlocal.risk: Remote collectors of the BIND statistics lose access; Pelagos reads them locally.
finding.transfer_without_read_key.descri: Transfers allowed by {{where}} leave {{key}} out: Pelagos cannot read the zone records.
finding.transfer_without_read_key.risk: None: the clients allowed today keep their access.
finding.update_without_admin_key.descrip: Zone {{zone}} does not accept updates signed with {{key}}: Pelagos cannot write its records.
finding.update_without_admin_key.risk: None: the keys allowed today keep their rights.
finding.update_without_admin_key.risk_in: None: the keys allowed today keep their rights. Every zone inheriting that allow-update accepts the key too.
finding.view_key.description: View {{view}} is selected by match-clients { {{clients}}; }: requests signed with {{read_key}} or {{admin_key}} reach the first view that matches this node, so Pelagos cannot read or write the zones of {{view}} reliably.
finding.view_key.proposal: Create key {{key}} (hmac-sha256); put `key {{key}};` first in the match-clients of view {{view}}; let {{key}} update and transfer the zones of {{view}}; use it as the key of view {{view}} (settings dns.view_keys.{{view}}).
finding.view_key.proposal_earlier: Create key {{key}} (hmac-sha256); put `key {{key}};` first in the match-clients of view {{view}} and `!key {{key}};` first in those of {{earlier}}; let {{key}} update and transfer the zones of {{view}}; use it as the key of view {{view}} (settings dns.view_keys.{{view}}).
finding.view_key.risk: Clients matched today keep their view: only requests signed with the new key change view. Views selected by match-destinations or match-recursive-only are not rewritten; check them after the change.
finding.weak_rndc_key.proposal: Regenerate {{key}} in {{new_algorithm}} with a new secret and restart named.
finding.weak_rndc_key.risk: Other tools using this key (scripts, a remote rndc) stop working until they get the new key.
finding.weak_shared_kea_key.d2_proposal: Dual-key switch: add {{new_key}} to the primary's BIND, switch D2, remove the old key.
finding.weak_shared_kea_key.description: The TSIG key {{key}} shared with Kea D2 uses {{algorithm}}.
finding.weak_shared_kea_key.proposal: Dual-key switch: add {{new_key}} ({{new_algorithm}}) to BIND next to the old key, switch D2 on every node, then remove the old key.
finding.weak_shared_kea_key.risk: During the switch both keys are accepted; DDNS updates keep working on every step.
finding.weak_tsig_key.proposal: Replace {{key}} by {{new_algorithm}} with a new secret.
finding.weak_tsig_key.risk: Every peer using this key (secondaries, primaries, update clients) needs the new secret at the same time, or transfers and updates with it fail.
